title: Chapter 771
paragraphs: Chapter 771
Episode 190. The Legacy of Malieth Hister (1)
Both Leuth and Yuria had completed their verification of Sayal.
Just like Luche, he had purely applied to join the Vamel Union.
The one most excited by the fact that a 'completed ultra-long-distance communication device' could have been developed more than three hundred years ago was, of course, Qwaul.

"If the contents written on this paper are true, then that engineer Zen must be a genius at the same level as me. There's no way our ancestors from Valeria would have been mediocre, very interesting indeed. But Valeria, what does it mean that Zen and your ancestor's bodies and souls are all left in the legacy?"
<All the knowledge, achievements, souls, and my physical body of Zen Rootber... all...
It must be left in Malieth's legacy.
As long as the enemies don't discover it, forever.>
It was a sentence written on the paper Sayal gave.
"I'm not sure either. Whether it's a metaphorical expression, or whether they actually sealed the body and soul through some method. I think we have to go there ourselves to confirm."
"If it's the latter, I might be able to meet Zen Rootber and this Qwaul. You'll also be able to meet your ancestor directly."

"No matter how special our family's magic is, I don't think that's likely. However, it's certain that the legacy has remained undiscovered by Zipple so far, so there will surely be a great harvest, whatever it is."
If Zipple had discovered Malieth's legacy, the rod of the tower masters wouldn't have only had the simple call function like now, and Sayal might not have been alive.

"Yes, yes. The part about being careful because the place called the legacy is infamous is a little concerning... but you'll be going with Jin, so there's no need to worry, right? There won't be many traps in this world that are so terrible that even that guy can't handle."
"Even before meeting Jin, when I traveled alone to dangerous legacies, I always managed well, so don't worry. Please sort out all the data related to the communication device until I return."
Since there were frequent long-range leaps, Qwaul gave Red Owl a quick maintenance.

The region where Malieth's transmission point was located was an island named 'Honka'. Since it was an uninhabited island located in the northern part of the empire, there was no need to worry about unnecessary friction with the enemies.
However, the problem was that the conditions for entering the legacy were somewhat intricate and demanding.
"It seems that the ancestor called Malieth... was quite a unique person."
As Red Owl arrived near the sea of Honka Island, Valeria said.
"Indeed. Looking at those entry conditions, I wonder if such a thing is possible with magic. No, it's definitely impossible."
Jin summoned Shuri and said.
Shuri swam towards Honka Island, pushing the Red Owl floating on the sea.
[Meowmeowmeow.]
"Hi, Shuri. Some of the conditions could be jokes, or some kind of test disguised as a joke. But no matter how strange they are, they're conditions left by my ancestor, so I'll follow them."
"Hmm."
As soon as they reached the island, Shuri basked in the sun, shaking off her body, and Jin anchored Red Owl at an appropriate place on the beach and made it invisible.
"Jin, are you ready?"
"Yes."
"Then let's try it one by one."
With that said, Valeria coughed awkwardly.
'My master's personality has really improved lately. Even if something was ridiculous or embarrassing, she would have spoken dryly in the past.'
Jin thought so and smiled inwardly.
However, he also felt embarrassed and funny.
"So the first thing... was it spinning around twenty times like an elephant's trunk after arriving on the island?"
At Jin's question, Valeria nodded.
Anyone who arrived at Honka Island to enter the legacy must spin around twenty times like an elephant's trunk and touch the ground.
That was the first condition.
The two of them looked around for a while, then assumed the posture of an elephant's trunk.
Then one by one, they started to spin around twenty times, in time with each other.
"Pfft."
"Cough, haha!"
As soon as they both touched the ground, laughter burst out without any order.
The second condition was to climb a tree inhabiting the island and mimic the cry of a monkey.
Despite the laughter explosion during the first condition, the two people felt embarrassed trying to make the sound of a monkey.
"Oo, oo-kee-kee…"
"Oo-kee…"
Shuri, who was watching them, tilted her head.
Subsequent conditions included crawling on all fours and roaring like a lion, singing two folk songs that they knew, etc.
The two of them fulfilled all these conditions while their feelings became increasingly indescribable.
Both of them were flushed.
"…Hmm, it feels like a strange experience."
"Hmm, hmm, now that we've done everything, it's time to connect the pentagram."
There were five magic devices on Honka Island, created by Malieth.
Jin and Valeria rode on Shuri and went around to find each of the magic device locations indicated in the letter.
Every time Valeria sent magic into the device, a blue light appeared.
When all five devices were activated, the light changed into a straight line and became a pentagram connecting the whole island.
The group took their places at the center of the pentagram.
"I'm curious about which guardian will appear."
The final gate was to deal with the guardian that was summoned in response to the pentagram.
"It's probably going to be a golem."
The letter only mentioned that a guardian would be summoned, but there was no talk about its combat power or other details.
Shortly after, the ground began to vibrate.
Jin didn't feel nervous at all, as he thought that whatever the guardian was, whether it be a golem or something else, it could never be a match for him.
[Greetings... To those who seek Mariet's legacy.]
Boom-!
Suddenly, the ground in front of the group cracked open, revealing something massive.
'A toad?'
A creature resembling a toad.
The guardian protecting the legacy was not a golem but a monster like Ozdoc or Bylam, who knew how to speak human language.
[My name is Honka, the master of this island. Tell me your names.]
"I am Jin Runcandel."
"I am Valeria Hister."

[Somehow, those who come to find me always bring a Hister who is not a Hister. Anyway, I can feel from beneath the ground that you've faithfully fulfilled all of Mariet's requirements. Had you missed even one, I wouldn't have appeared.]
At the thought that those embarrassing actions weren't entirely in vain, the two felt relief.
"I'm relieved, is it over if we defeat you now?"
At Valeria's question, Honka attempted to nod.
He recalled the memory of scolding two humans (Zen Routver and the Hister who brought him) who had come about 350 years ago.
However, Honka glanced at Jin and thought to himself,
'...If I fight with that human named Jin Runcandel, I won't be able to pick up even my bones?'
Honka was by no means a weak creature.
A monster that had formed self-awareness by creating its own realm over thousands of years couldn't be weak.
The problem was that Jin was the opponent.
[Well... enough, enough. Just stop. I'll let you in, so stop.]
As Jin lifted his hand to the sword at his waist, Honka decided to stop the fight.
"That's convenient, but why?"
[You're too strong... Valeria Hister, they say that Mariet's legacy is dangerous, but you're ruthless. Bringing such a monster here? Isn't that too easy?]
Jin and Valeria didn't reply, blinking their eyes.
They hadn't expected the guardian to react like this.
"You've made a wise choice."
Jin said, lowering his hand from his waist.
[However, there is a condition.]
"Condition?"
[...Inside the legacy, there are several traps and equipment painstakingly installed by Mariet while she was alive. Mariet was very satisfied, considering them her works of art.]
"Judging by your words, it seems you were very close to my ancestors, Honka."

[Yes, Valeria Hister. It's thanks to Mariet that I took up residence on this island and started using the name Honka. Mariet was definitely eccentric, but she was my only friend. Anyway, I can't bear to see the creature you brought ruin her works so wantonly.]
"Can't you prevent the traps from activating?"
[I don't have that authority.]
"So what do you want us to do?"
[Regardless of what traps are present, don't destroy them, just bypass them. For the successors who will come after you. Surely, you won't dislike even that little effort?]
The next successor.
At those words, Valeria felt something welled up in her heart.
Until just a few years ago, she had been entirely alone in this world.
But now, she had Jin and her comrades, Riet became her root and family, and the monster who had been a friend of her ancestor was asking her to think about her descendants.

[You should have come here much sooner. The difficulty set by Mariet is geared towards geniuses in their prime growth period. That's why the engineer and the Hister who came 350 years ago had such a hard time. Well... actually, I only started to remember all this recently.]
It was a recent event for Honka to recall Zen and the Hister who came 350 years ago, even to recall Mariet who had been his only friend.
Until the history manipulation applied to Hister by Zipple weakened, Honka had stayed on this island with a vague sense of mission.
"We will do as you say. We will enter without destroying a single one."
[Good, I'll trust you and open the legacy.]
Honka's massive body rolled two rounds backward.
Then a thick iron door installed below the hole from which Honka emerged was revealed.
[Go and come back. And leave this pet here. Let it play while you're gone.]
[Meow.]
As soon as Jin opened the iron door, a light so bright that it was hard to believe it was underground stabbed their eyes.
Just as they were about to deploy a shield, Honka outside the cave blew a powerful gust of wind at them.
The wind, shot like a cannon, was pushing them into the door.
The first trap was apparently a precipice.
[Tch, this is the only prank that might work on those guys. But it probably won't be very effective either.]
Just as Honka said, the two of them were not flustered at all as they fell underground.
After all, they could just create sword wind or magic to offset the shock when they hit the ground.
[Mariet, it looks like this one will end disappointingly. Let's look forward to the next. Still, I'm glad to see that your descendants are not extinct.]
[Meow.]
Saying that, Honka stretched out with Shuri.
